key_insight: Zero-point electron–phonon coupling reshapes the shift-current spectrum of monolayer MoS2 even when band dispersion changes very little.
engineering_relevance: Accounting for electron–phonon coupling could enable strain- and temperature-based tuning of nonlinear photocurrents for photodetection and photovoltaic energy conversion.
method: Evaluate band-renormalized shift current from quantum virtual-phonon coupling.
evidence_signal: Calculations predict new low-energy peaks, redshifted higher-energy features, sharp tuning under 1.0% strain, and enhancement with increasing temperature.
watch_item: The abstract reports computational predictions, not experimental validation or demonstrated solar-cell efficiency gains, and describes no AI method.
paper_title: Zero-Point Renormalization Reshapes the Shift Current: The Role of Electron-Phonon Coupling
